notes.id: Uang pangkal = uang pengembangan dan sarana pendidikan. Jalur khusus (dari SD Santa Maria Surabaya/Sidoarjo): Rp14.200.000, SPP Rp1.400.000. Jalur prestasi: Rp15.200.000, SPP Rp1.500.000. Jalur umum I: Rp16.200.000, SPP Rp1.600.000. Potongan Rp500.000 per keluarga untuk saudara kandung; potongan 5% jika uang pengembangan dibayar lunas; cicilan 50% lalu 5 kali angsuran; potongan 5% jika SPP 1 tahun dilunasi Juli–Agustus 2027.
notes.en: Entry fee = development & facilities fee. Special track (from SD Santa Maria Surabaya/Sidoarjo): Rp14,200,000, tuition Rp1,400,000. Achievement track: Rp15,200,000, tuition Rp1,500,000. General track I: Rp16,200,000, tuition Rp1,600,000. Rp500,000 sibling discount per family; 5% off if the development fee is paid in full; or 50% upfront then 5 monthly instalments; 5% off if a full year's tuition is paid in July–August 2027.

source.title: SPMB SMP Santa Maria Surabaya TA 2027/2028 (situs resmi)

period.id: Tahap 1 (jalur prestasi): pendaftaran 1–10 September 2026; tes literasi dan numerasi 12 September 2026.
period.en: Stage 1 (achievement track): registration 1–10 September 2026; literacy and numeracy test 12 September 2026.

steps.id: Beli formulir SPMB Rp325.000 via VA BCA.
steps.en: Buy the SPMB form (Rp325,000) via BCA virtual account.

steps.id: Isi data dan unggah berkas (scan/foto dokumen asli, maks. 1 MB).
steps.en: Enter details and upload documents (scans/photos of originals, max 1 MB).

steps.id: Ikuti tes literasi dan numerasi (Bahasa Indonesia dan Matematika kelas 5 SD).
steps.en: Take the literacy and numeracy test (grade 5 Indonesian and maths).

steps.id: Diterima jika lolos filter akademis dan filter keuangan (uang pengembangan dan uang kegiatan lunas).
steps.en: Accepted once both the academic filter and the financial filter (development and activity fees paid) are passed.

documents.en: Signed statement with Rp10,000 duty stamp

documents.id: Rapor kelas IV dan V semester 1 dan 2
documents.en: Grade 4 and 5 report cards, both semesters

documents.id: Surat baptis Katolik (bagi yang sudah dibaptis)
